description: GSMA Intelligence publishes mobile network coverage data supplied directly by mobile network operators worldwide. Three products are listed: Mobile Coverage Explorer, a global raster dataset available annually from 2010 to 2025; Mobile Coverage Legacy, a historical vector dataset of coverage submitted between 1999 and 2009; and Collins Coverage, a web mapping tool built with Collins Bartholomew. An interactive map on the page shows operators and coverage areas by country, and the maps are enriched with an open dataset that interpolates cell tower locations. Producer: GSMA Intelligence, which lets operators submit coverage data at no cost. Coverage: global, operator by operator. Access: the interactive map is public; the datasets are obtained through a contact form. Licence and cost: not stated, treated as on request. Caveats: coverage is operator-declared, not independently measured, and the raster and vector products cannot be inspected without contacting the provider. Simulation uses: the annual rasters give a historical and current coverage layer for capacity, access and resilience models of mobile networks. Related record: OpenCelliD (data-opencellid), the open tower dataset.
